SELECT cd_sub.pref_name AS substrate_name,
       cs_sub.canonical_smiles AS substrate_smiles,
       cd_met.pref_name AS parent_name,
       cs_met.canonical_smiles AS parent_smiles,
       m.met_conversion AS met_conversion,
       m.pathway_key AS pathway_key,
       m.enzyme_name AS enzyme_name
FROM metabolism m
LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary cd_sub ON m.substrate_record_id = cd_sub.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs_sub ON cd_sub.molregno = cs_sub.molregno
LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary cd_met ON m.metabolite_record_id = cd_met.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs_met ON cd_met.molregno = cs_met.molregno
WHERE m.organism = 'Callithrix jacchus'
ORDER BY m.met_id ASC
LIMIT 200;
